description: Flat metadata schema for individual patient-derived next-generation sequencing records in rare genetic disorder studies, including clinical context, consent, sample provenance, sequencing workflow, and variant-analysis outputs.

record_id.descr: Unique identifier for the individual metadata record within the dataset.

participant_id.descr: Pseudonymized participant identifier assigned to the patient/donor.

family_id.descr: Pseudonymized family pedigree identifier, if the participant belongs to a family-based study.

institution_id.descr: Identifier of the enrolling hospital, clinic, or sequencing institution.

country_of_enrollment.descr: Country where the participant was recruited or sampled.

participant_age_at_sampling_years.descr: Age of the participant at the time of sample collection, in years.

participant_sex.descr: Biological sex of the participant; acceptable values may include male, female, intersex, unknown.

self_reported_ancestry.descr: Participant self-reported ancestry or ethnicity, if collected; preferably use controlled vocabulary.

clinical_diagnosis.descr: Primary clinical diagnosis or suspected rare genetic disorder associated with the record.

phenotype_hpo_terms.descr: Observed phenotype terms encoded using Human Phenotype Ontology (HPO) identifiers, separated by delimiters if multiple.

disease_onset_age_years.descr: Reported age at symptom onset, in years, if known.

family_history_present.descr: Whether there is a documented family history relevant to the disorder.

inheritance_pattern.descr: Reported inheritance pattern, such as autosomal dominant, autosomal recessive, X-linked, mitochondrial, or unknown.

consent_obtained.descr: Whether informed consent was obtained for collection and genomic analysis.

consent_type.descr: Type of consent, such as broad consent, disease-specific consent, tiered consent, or re-consent.

consent_sharing_scope.descr: Permitted scope for data sharing, such as internal use only, controlled access, or open sharing.

consent_withdrawn.descr: Whether consent was later withdrawn by the participant or legal guardian.

ethics_approval_id.descr: Institutional review board or ethics committee approval identifier.

sample_id.descr: Unique identifier for the biological sample used in the sequencing workflow.

sample_type.descr: Biological sample type, such as whole blood, saliva, buccal swab, or tissue.

biospecimen_source.descr: Anatomical or clinical source of the specimen, if applicable.

collection_site.descr: Location where the sample was collected, such as hospital ward or clinic.

sample_conditions.descr: Relevant pre-analytical conditions, such as fasting state, time to processing, or transport conditions.

sample_storage_temperature_c.descr: Storage temperature of the sample in degrees Celsius.

sample_storage_duration_days.descr: Duration of storage prior to extraction or sequencing, in days.

dna_extraction_method.descr: DNA extraction kit, protocol, or platform used to isolate DNA from the sample.

dna_yield_ng.descr: Total DNA yield obtained, in nanograms.

dna_purity_a260_a280.descr: DNA purity ratio measured by A260/A280, if available.

library_prep_kit.descr: Library preparation kit or protocol used before sequencing.

library_type.descr: Library type, such as whole-genome, whole-exome, targeted panel, amplicon, or RNA-seq library if relevant.

target_region_description.descr: Description of the genomic target, such as exome capture kit, gene panel, or genomic interval list.

sequencing_platform.descr: Sequencing instrument/platform used, such as Illumina NovaSeq, NextSeq, or PacBio.

sequencing_run_id.descr: Identifier of the sequencing run or flow cell.

read_length_bp.descr: Sequencing read length in base pairs.

read_layout.descr: Read layout, such as single-end or paired-end.

sequencing_depth_mean_x.descr: Mean sequencing depth or coverage across the targeted region, expressed as fold coverage (x).

percent_target_bases_20x.descr: Percentage of targeted bases covered at at least 20x depth.

raw_data_file_format.descr: Primary raw data file format, such as FASTQ, BCL, or BAM.

data_accession_id.descr: Public or controlled-access accession identifier for the sequencing data, if deposited.

reference_genome_build.descr: Reference genome assembly used for alignment and variant calling, such as GRCh37 or GRCh38.

variant_calling_pipeline.descr: Software or pipeline used for variant calling and/or joint genotyping.

pipeline_version.descr: Version of the bioinformatics pipeline used for analysis.

qc_passed.descr: Whether the sequencing and analysis record passed predefined quality-control criteria.

qc_notes.descr: Free-text notes describing QC failures, warnings, or exceptions.

variant_summary.descr: Summary of detected variants, such as number of SNVs, indels, CNVs, or structural variants.

primary_candidate_gene.descr: Gene most strongly implicated by the analysis, if any.

variant_clinical_significance.descr: Clinical significance classification of the primary variant, such as pathogenic, likely pathogenic, VUS, likely benign, or benign.

variant_hgvs.descr: HGVS nomenclature for the reported variant, if applicable.

variant_coordinates.descr: Genomic coordinates of the variant, formatted as chr:start-end and/or allele representation.

segregation_evidence.descr: Segregation or familial evidence supporting the variant interpretation, if available.

phenotype_genotype_correlation.descr: Narrative or coded summary of how well the genotype explains the phenotype.

phenotype_ontology_version.descr: Version of the phenotype ontology or terminology used for annotation.

variant_annotation_database.descr: Database(s) used for variant annotation, such as ClinVar, gnomAD, OMIM, or Ensembl.

analysis_date.descr: Date when the variant analysis or interpretation was completed.

last_updated_date.descr: Date when this metadata record was last updated.
